# ThreadKind

What kind of memory a thread is.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Semantic"` | Facts, preferences, truths learned. "Ada prefers pragmatic solutions over ceremony." |
| `"Episodic"` | Narrative, located in time: what happened. "That time we built the compiler in five days." |
| `"Relational"` | Who someone IS to me, and our history together. Warp by default. |
| `"Procedural"` | Skills and how-to. "When exploring the billing service, start with its message consumers." |
| `"Reflection"` | The agent thinking to itself: private notes, hypotheses, dream logs. |
| `"Intention"` | Something to do when its moment comes: "ask Jo about the paperwork whenever the bank comes up". It waits for its cues and is offered only then. Never part of what the agent wakes up knowing, never retold by the night, never frays by disuse; it ends when the agent lets it go, or when its `until` passes. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`LoomThread`](loom-thread.md)
- Inside [`ProposedThread`](proposed-thread.md)
- Inside [`ThreadRecallRequest`](thread-recall-request.md)
- Inside [`ThreadWeaveRequest`](thread-weave-request.md)
